name: Haruiro Ouse
source:
There is a love cherry tree and it has a local legend handed down for centuries. A boy and a girl who meet under the tree fall in love. However, it makes no difference to Riku. But one day, he meets a girl under the tree in full bloom. "I'll tell you what." She smiles and says, "You'll fall in love with me..."

[From Himeya Shop]
